# Fixtures

`index-v03.json` is the index the 0.3 test fixtures were generated from
(`tests/arexx/make-arexx-fixtures.py`, `tests/make-real-upgrade-fixture.py`).
It is pinned so the tests do not change when the published catalogue does.
It is not the current catalogue; that is in
[arospkg-index](https://github.com/tomaszstaniak/arospkg-index).
